twin_track_frontend_contract.purpose: 把双轨京张作为前台空间总纲，把 JZ-AIOS、G0—G3、证据门和权利边界保留为后台治理内核；该合同只表达空间语法和公众可读旅程，不增加场景、边界或建设承诺。
twin_track_frontend_contract.purpose_en: Make Twin-track Jing-Zhang the front-stage spatial master plan while retaining JZ-AIOS, G0–G3, evidence gates, and rights boundaries as the back-stage governance kernel. This contract expresses spatial syntax and a readable public journey only; it adds no scene, boundary, or construction commitment.

daily_track.continuity: continuous ordinary public life; no proof equipment or account gate
daily_track.entry_rule: anyone may enter, pause, ask, leave, or continue without registration, QR code, or AI

proof_track.continuity: intermittent, time-bounded, localized, and removable; never a continuous occupied strip
proof_track.activation: voluntary public learning or future-approved bounded test only after the relevant G1 evidence contract is complete
proof_track.protected_path: daily track remains open and the non-AI comparator remains available
proof_track.stop_rule: any public harm, boundary breach, failed human handoff, stale source, or material rights/safeguarding gap stops the proof overlay

switchyards.role_zh: 把公共问题接入共创、共学和公共评议；连续日常街先于任何验证叠层。
switchyards.role_en: Receives public problems into co-creation, learning, and public review; the continuous daily street comes before any proof overlay.

switchyards.role_zh: 把已提出的问题转为离线、低风险、可停止的验证；公众观察边、人工接管和急停边不可被占用。
switchyards.role_en: Turns a submitted problem into offline, low-risk, stoppable verification; the public observation edge, staffed takeover, and physical-stop edge remain protected.

switchyards.role_zh: 把通过、失败和修正变成可读的公共发布与人工服务；通勤、静音休憩和来源纠错优先。
switchyards.role_en: Makes passed, failed, and corrected evidence readable through public release and staffed service; commuting, quiet rest, and source correction take priority.

failure_siding.spatial_role: temporary isolation, staffed explanation, detour, correction, and return to the daily track
failure_siding.restart_rule: no proof overlay restarts until the declared stop condition, accountable handoff, corrected source, and independent retest are closed

six_city_signals.public_question: 这里是日常、验证还是停止？
six_city_signals.public_question_en: Is this daily, proof, or stopped?

civic_timetable.rule_zh: 连续日常轨开放；人工、无屏和非 AI 路径可用。
civic_timetable.rule_en: The daily track is open; staffed, screen-free, and non-AI paths remain available.

civic_timetable.rule_zh: 静音、低照度、无屏优先；不以活动或验证占用普通生活。
civic_timetable.rule_en: Quiet, low-light, screen-free use takes priority; ordinary life is not displaced by events or proof.

civic_timetable.rule_zh: 验证轨只在公告、批准和有责任人的时段出现，不形成连续占地。
civic_timetable.rule_en: The proof track appears only in announced, approved, accountable windows and never becomes a continuous occupied strip.

civic_timetable.window: any time a stop condition is declared
civic_timetable.rule_zh: 停止→人工解释→失败侧线→恢复日常；公众无需等待系统或注册。
civic_timetable.rule_en: Stop → staffed explanation → failure siding → return to daily use; the public need not wait for a system or register.

typical_section.section_rule: daily track is continuous; proof overlay is intermittent; staffed station, screen-free node, and recovery garden are distinct spatial roles
typical_section.section_rule_zh: 日常轨连续；验证叠层间歇；人工站房、无屏节点和恢复花园是不同空间角色。

readable_journey.action_zh: 从既有入口进入，沿连续日常轨步行、通勤、休憩或办事。
readable_journey.action_en: Enter from an existing access and walk, commute, rest, or use a service along the continuous daily track.

readable_journey.action_zh: 通过入口、时段、状态、人工、来源、退出六类信号判断是否继续；不注册、不扫码也能完成基本任务。
readable_journey.action_en: Read the six signals—entry, time, state, human, source, and exit; the basic task works without registration, a QR code, or AI.

readable_journey.action_zh: 只有自愿进入公告的验证窗口，才经换轨场接入间歇验证轨；日常轨和非 AI 对照仍在旁侧。
readable_journey.action_en: Only a voluntary, announced proof window uses a switchyard to enter the intermittent proof track; the daily track and non-AI comparator remain beside it.

readable_journey.action_zh: 任何人都可以说停、找人工、绕行、离开或申诉；失败侧线隔离验证叠层，不把故障变成日常阻断。
readable_journey.action_en: Anyone may stop, ask a person, detour, leave, or appeal; the failure siding isolates the proof overlay instead of blocking daily life.

readable_journey.action_zh: 修正来源、完成责任交接和独立复测后，才撤除侧线并恢复普通状态；否则保持 G0/退出。
readable_journey.action_en: Only after source correction, accountable handoff, and independent retest does the siding close and ordinary use return; otherwise remain G0 or exit.

round2_spatial_deepening.purpose_zh: 把众智园、原点社区和大钟寺深化为三种不可机械复制的公共空间原型，并让平面、关系剖面、首层界面、连续非 AI / 无障碍意图线、人工交接、可拆构件、四态与场所恢复使用同一证据合同。

maintenance_urbanism_contract.label_zh: 维护型城市：从日常问题到普通基线
maintenance_urbanism_contract.label_en: Maintenance urbanism: from everyday issue to ordinary baseline
maintenance_urbanism_contract.purpose_zh: 在不新增场景、项目、几何或成熟度的前提下，把既有十二个场景和八个项目组织为可审计的维护任务、人工旅程、全寿命字段与停止/退役闭环。
maintenance_urbanism_contract.purpose_en: Without adding scenes, projects, geometry, or maturity, organise the existing twelve scenes and eight projects into auditable maintenance tasks, human journeys, lifecycle fields, and a stop/retirement loop.

global_guards.rule_zh: 维护任务族按用户目标命名，不是新场景、项目编号、批准、采购、人员确认或现实服务。
global_guards.rule_en: Maintenance task families are named for user goals; they are not new scenes, project numbers, approvals, procurement, confirmed personnel, or real services.

task_families.user_goal_zh: 让既有日常路径、人工服务与共同测试可被识别、修复和复核。
task_families.user_goal_en: Make existing daily routes, staffed service, and co-testing identifiable, repairable, and recheckable.

task_families.user_goal_zh: 维护既有舒适、遮阴、安静、能耗与环境条件，不把设备当成效果。
task_families.user_goal_en: Maintain existing comfort, shade, quiet, energy, and environmental conditions without treating equipment as an outcome.

task_families.user_goal_zh: 让失败公开、人工交接、纠正和普通服务恢复可追溯。
task_families.user_goal_en: Keep published failure, staffed handoff, correction, and return of ordinary service traceable.

task_families.user_goal_zh: 让来源、叙事、标识与纠错接受策展和独立复核。
task_families.user_goal_en: Subject sources, narratives, labels, and corrections to curatorial and independent recheck.

task_families.user_goal_zh: 用可理解的人工与非 AI 路径支持小微经营者的问题进入、转交和恢复。
task_families.user_goal_en: Support small operators through understandable staffed and non-AI routes for issue entry, transfer, and recovery.

closed_human_journey.label_en: retirement and return to ordinary baseline

visible_human_roles.concept_action: inspect, repair, or decline/transfer pending a confirmed role
inspect, clean/adjust, or flag a non-visible condition
receive, explain, provide non-AI service, or hand off
co-test and independently flag an accessibility gap without being treated as a data source

decision_rules.continue: only after independent recheck closes and ordinary/non-AI access is preserved; currently pending
decision_rules.correct: if the recheck finds a remediable issue, return to an earlier lifecycle step without claiming completion
decision_rules.stop: stop if a safe staffed/non-AI route is absent, an independent recheck fails, a rights/accessibility risk occurs, or ordinary baseline cannot be restored
decision_rules.repeated_failure: record a repeated failure only after future verified records exist; repeated unresolved failure requires a retirement review
decision_rules.retirement: remove temporary components, preserve ordinary access and staffed service, close only the minimum evidence record, and return to ordinary baseline; current status pending

urban_metabolism_contract.purpose_zh: 把现有十二场景按三处空间原型回链到七类资源、完整系统边界、组件退出去向和公共 NO-GO 门；只增强资源可审计性，不改变空间、场景或成熟度。
urban_metabolism_contract.purpose_en: Backlink the twelve existing scenes in the three spatial prototypes to seven resources, a whole-system boundary, component exit destinations, and a public NO-GO gate. This strengthens resource auditability only and changes no space, scene, or maturity.

key_area_resource_crosswalk.exit_focus: equipment isolation, repair/return/recycling, minimum incident record, continuous bypass, and independent place restoration
withdraw/delete records, remove event kit and temporary marks, restore two courts and the daily street before restart discussion
take automated output offline, export/correct/close records, retain same-task staffed service, remove kit, and retest all four movement arms

urban_metabolism_contract.whole_system_rule: Each future comparison must include server/cloud, edge, network, end device, sensing/display/fixings, staffed and non-AI baseline, human review/recovery, and place restoration unless a typed not_applicable reason is independently accepted.
urban_metabolism_contract.typed_unknown_rule: Use only not_applicable, not_measured, external_confirmation_required, not_yet_authorized, or not_fully_cleared with a reason and replacement evidence path; never silently omit a burden.
urban_metabolism_contract.public_no_go_rule: A valid denominator, evidence anchors, accepted responsibility, same-task non-AI baseline, vendor export/repair/exit terms, component destination, place restoration, and independent retest must all close before any future PASS discussion; PASS never grants deployment authorization.

counterexample_audit.test: Server or model compute is counted while network, end device, staff, or place recovery is omitted.
An industry average, nameplate, vendor claim, or simulation is labelled as a project measurement.
A 100% field-coverage ratio is interpreted as environmental performance or readiness.
Equipment, data, service, or temporary-place components have no accountable exit destination.
A future resource PASS is treated as deployment, procurement, site, maturity, or rights authorization.

non_ai_first_public_city_contract.purpose_zh: 把七项永久公共权利、纸面/口头/人工入口、同任务双路径、三处空间化服务旅程、群体分层验收和停止恢复统一为一套前台空间服务合同。
non_ai_first_public_city_contract.purpose_en: Unify seven permanent public rights, paper/oral/staffed entry, two paths to the same task, three place-specific service journeys, group-specific acceptance, and stop/recovery in one front-stage spatial-service contract.

spatial_service_crosswalk.non_ai_entry: physical state sign, staffed takeover point, paper stop or appeal
spatial_service_crosswalk.optional_ai_overlay: bounded offline proof after future gates only
spatial_service_crosswalk.stop: physically isolate equipment while the ordinary path remains
spatial_service_crosswalk.recovery: remove equipment, cables, enclosure, sound, light, and queue; independently recheck path and place

spatial_service_crosswalk.non_ai_entry: screen-free waiting, paper or oral issue, staffed explanation and withdrawal
spatial_service_crosswalk.optional_ai_overlay: voluntary co-learning separate from passage and basic service
spatial_service_crosswalk.stop: stop collection and matching while paper and staffed service remain
spatial_service_crosswalk.recovery: remove screen, sound, event kit, collection state, and temporary marks; restore resident daily use

spatial_service_crosswalk.non_ai_entry: physical source status, dual-entry staffed desk, paper correction or appeal
spatial_service_crosswalk.optional_ai_overlay: source-bounded navigation beside rather than over staffed service
spatial_service_crosswalk.stop: take automated output offline while staffed and source-list service remain
spatial_service_crosswalk.recovery: correct source and queue, clear event kit, and retest all four movement arms

required_role_types.purpose: receive paper, oral, telephone, or in-person requests
own status, evidence supplement, correction, suspension, and review
test route and service sequence with required support
verify parity and place recovery before restart

counterexample_audit.test: A person without an account can enter, complete the basic task, receive a durable status reference, appeal or withdraw, and leave.
A screen-free user can discover the non-AI path before encountering the optional AI path.
A hard stop removes automated privilege but does not remove ordinary passage or the accountable human route.
Older, disabled, low-digital-literacy, and no-account results cannot be hidden inside an overall average.
Documentation completeness cannot issue a field PASS or maturity upgrade.

antifragile_failure_governance_contract.writeback_rule_zh: 暂停、复核、恢复、撤回和退役必须准备三载体同事件回写；缺失或冲突时向最保守的运行、授权和服务组合 fail-closed，成熟度不自动变化。
antifragile_failure_governance_contract.writeback_rule_en: Pause, review, recovery, withdrawal, and retirement must prepare same-event writebacks across all three carriers. Missing or conflicting entries fail closed to the most conservative runtime, authorization, and service combination, without automatic maturity change.
restart_requires: correction appended without overwriting prior evidence
retirement_requires: ordinary place and same-task service restoration
independent acceptance or explicit open gap
antifragile_failure_governance_contract.permanent_authorization_boundary: file check, synthetic replay, machine PASS, independent retest, or restoration acceptance does not authorize trial, procurement, construction, deployment, maturity advancement, site/professional approval, rights clearance, or a real-world outcome claim

same_task_parity.task: receive an understandable human-confirmed climate-safety action and choose ordinary movement, rest, staffed help, or exit
same_task_parity.primary_path: high-contrast physical notice and ordinary route independent of account, QR, screen, sensor, model, network, or AI
same_task_parity.optional_path: separately disclosed and voluntary assisted prompt using only future approved minimum data and the same human confirmation

proof_limits: green-space ratio is not thermal comfort
concept nodes or drawing coverage are not accessible-rest or continuous-shade results
sensor count and synthetic PASS are not warning accuracy
a conceptual section is not hydraulic, sponge-city, drainage-capacity, municipal, fire, railway, or ecological approval
removable drawing intent is not removal or place-restoration performance
climate_resilience_corridor_contract.authorization_boundary: This contract and its visual checks explain G0 relationships only and authorize no site, survey, thermal, hydrological, ecological, activity, procurement, installation, construction, operation, deployment, maturity, professional, rights, or outcome claim.

required_sequence: read the referenced provisional GeoJSON and source register
check each crosswalk ID against the referenced file
treat spatial response and interface links as conceptual mappings
replace provisional geometry and unknowns only with organizer or qualified-owner evidence
re-run geometry, metrics, drawings, HTML, self-check and manifest after replacement
review_protocol.coverage_definition: The ratio measures presence of required crosswalk fields in the three records; it is not field coverage, partner confirmation, approval, operating performance, or public-value evidence.
